title: changelog.com before commit 7b35e829 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows unauthenticated…
description: A missing authorization vulnerability in changelog.com before commit 7b35e829 allows unauthenticated attackers to access unpublished content. The flaw affects preview routes in PostController, NewsIssueController, and NewsItemController, enabling attackers to read draft posts, unsent newsletters, and declined news items by enumerating identifiers.
